endorsements.name: Jacob Olcott
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-2107
endorsements.description: The MiCODUS MV720 GPS tracker API server has an authentication mechanism that allows devices to use a hard-coded master password. This may allow an attacker to send SMS commands directly to the GPS tracker as if they were coming from the GPS owner’s mobile number.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)
